_doc: Lens per-surface rubric — the sourced, versioned contract the vision judge (Layer 2) scores each frame against. Checks are PIXEL judgments on the rendered page, sourced from theme-page-recipes (section ORDER), the niche taste pack (premium scorecard + forbidden patterns), and decoder teardowns (N≥5 reference brands). fix_owner routes Layer-4 autofix. severity_if_fail: blocker → gate #18 BLOCK; warning → WARN (≥2 frames escalates to systemic blocker). #12: an optional `mobile_overlay` array carries checks that score ONLY on mobile-viewport frames (tap-target, thumb-reach, sticky-ATC) — lens-judge merges them into checks for mobile frames via effectiveChecks().

shape.mobile_overlay: [same shape as checks] — optional; scored on mobile frames only
